_overlay_doc: ADDITIVE v1 overlay for specimens/internet.json (never duplicates base data). Web-grounded 2026-06-10. All ids match base specimen ids exactly. theory_dna shares are DISCLOSED ESTIMATES (historiographic consensus), never measured bits; confidence capped at 0.5. Lifecycle dates: Baran/Davies/Pouzin spot-verified by web; remaining dates are standard biographical/institutional record (Wikipedia-grade), confidence set accordingly.

now_extension.what: TCP/IP at 50: IEEE Triple Milestone dedications (SRI/PARC + Computer History Museum) for the May 1974 Cerf-Kahn paper; Cerf and Kahn reflect publicly on the weld's birth.

Automated traffic surpasses human traffic for the first time (51% of all web traffic, Imperva/Thales 2025 Bad Bot Report) - AI crawlers and bots become the network's majority occupant; the child's traffic mix inverts.

US net neutrality struck down: the Sixth Circuit (applying Loper Bright, post-Chevron) vacates the FCC's 2024 Title II open-internet order - the two-decade US regulatory battle over the end-to-end/meaning-frame governance of the child ends deregulatory, absent Congress.

Cloudflare (serving ~20% of the web) flips the open-crawl DEFAULT: AI crawlers blocked unless permitted, plus a Pay Per Crawl marketplace ('Content Independence Day') - the open-architecture default contested at the content layer; a protocol-wars-shaped open-vs-permissioned contest reopens.

Pew: Google AI Overviews halve click-through (8% vs 15%); zero-click searches rise 56%->69% (May 2024->May 2025) - the open web's referral/traffic economic model decays as AI answer engines intermediate the harvest layer.

UNGA adopts the WSIS+20 outcome document: the Internet Governance Forum made a PERMANENT UN forum; multistakeholder governance reaffirmed over state-centric/multilateral alternatives - the h-governance lineage consolidates a 20-year contest.

act-ptts.founded: 19th-20th c. national monopolies; broken up/privatized 1980s-1990s (deregulation era)

sw-packet-concept.formulated: 1964-1966 (Baran's On Distributed Communications; Davies' NPL design)

sw-openarch-root.named: retrospectively ('open architecture' fixed by Leiner et al. 1997 'Brief History')

sw-gateway.named: 'router' displaces 'gateway' from the mid-1980s; commercial product 1984- (Cisco)

cultural_harvest[2].consolidated: 1998-2000s (open-source movement adopts the template; later 'decentralization' discourse)

rel-osi.when: 1994-1996 (GOSIP drops the OSI mandate 1994-95); residues absorbed into Internet practice (X.509 certificates, IS-IS routing)

rel-x25.when: decline from 1991 (JANET IP overtakes); legacy niches (ATMs, aviation, telemetry) into the 2000s-2010s; Transpac closed 2012

rel-minitel.when: 2012-06-30 (service shut down, displaced by the Internet)

rel-proprietary.when: 1990s (IBM/DEC adopt TCP/IP; SNA/DECnet retreat to legacy enclaves)

rel-arpanet.when: 1990-02-28 (decommissioned; sites migrated into the Internet) - relation:influence in base, included for fade rendering

theory_dna._basis_doc: Shares are ESTIMATES of load-bearing contribution to child-internet, basis = historiographic consensus on component contributions (Leiner et al. 1997; Russell; Abbate-grade record; base specimen weld reading). NOT measured bits; gain_v2 numbers do not exist for this specimen. Shares sum to 1.0 with novel_residue. Confidence 0.5 (cap honored).

pf-baran.basis: one of two independent packet-switching roots (distributed/survivable routing); co-credited with Davies by historians + Inventors Hall of Fame

pf-davies.basis: independent invention + the term 'packet'; NPL design reached ARPANET via Roberts/Scantlebury

pf-kleinrock.basis: queueing analysis load-bearing for network performance; ORIGIN claim contested - kept low per base discrepancy[1]

pf-kahn-openarch.basis: the four ground rules define the child's federation architecture - the largest single architectural input

pf-datagram.basis: connectionless IP core IS CYCLADES' datagram carried forward (Cerf-Kahn 1974 acknowledgment)

pf-e2e.basis: the thin-waist/host-intelligence design spine (practiced in CYCLADES/TCP; articulated Saltzer-Reed-Clark 1981)

novel_residue.basis: the internetworking synergy itself: gateway architecture + TCP/IP engineering + federation-without-central-control, unreachable from any parent alone (the base weld's joint-surprise). Conceptually the gain_v2 quantity, rendered ONLY as a disclosed estimate
